description: Use Apple's Alex voice with NVDA. Open NVDA Settings and choose Alex, or open Tools, Alex setup, to download and set it up. Downloads come directly from Apple and show progress. You can keep the newer and older speech engines, switch between them, and remove downloads you no longer need. Apple's voice and engine files are not included.
changelog: Includes the profile-switching fix from 0.2.1 and the license notices for the first Add-on Store submission. Your existing downloads are kept.
